title: Violet Seed Sanctuary
description: A floating violet energy seed held between four eroded limestone sails by currents that wind around the body; references: ref_04_white_ribbed_arches and ref_07_violet_crater.

review.notes: Round 2. Fixed: the transmission is gone (the seed is opaque now), the sail joints are tighter and the limestone is ivory instead of camouflage grey. Still open: (1) form_detail, worse than round 1: the seed is now a smooth jelly-bean blob with soft pink-violet gradients (hero.jpg, closeup.jpg). It has no readable structure: no plates, ribs or petals with sharp edges, and no openings onto a bright heart. (2) material: no narrow bright filaments on a dark violet base as in the violet_energy swatch; the gradient goes up to lilac pink, which reads as soft plastic, not energy. (3) currents: still uniform-width tubes with no visible bright inner line and no taper. One still loops back and crosses in front of the lower seed (closeup.jpg, turn_020). (4) style/defects: the sail socket on the rear sail is still tinted pink/mauve with a pink stain (closeup.jpg, closeup_base right), and the flat octagonal paving slabs at the sail feet look like CG placeholders. Fix: model a faceted or plated seed with gaps through which one bright core shows, emissive filaments on dark violet, tapered currents with a bright core that never cross the front of the seed, neutral ivory sockets, and irregular broken slabs.
